verdict.rationale: Kushki is a payment gateway/aggregator, so controlling the payout schedule and seeing a per-payout breakdown of charges, fees, and refunds is a fair question for it. The evidence pack does not document settlement schedules or payout reconciliation reports. The nearby items cover different capabilities and earn no credit: supplier/employee disbursements (docs-18), scheduled recurring charges (docs-30), and refund handling (docs-8/23).
